thread:
ana_sales: FYI Jun from the prospect asked for ISO27001 cert, SOC2 Type II report (redacted ok), and a pen-test attestation for the POC. Wants everything by EOD Friday. Also asked if sharing this triggers extra legal requirements or pricing changes. tagging @eric_se @devin_security @sarah_legal

eric_se: Got it. POC will run on dedicated infra, right? If so we can confirm isolation details. tagging @devin_security to confirm what artifacts we can share.

devin_security: Short answer: we can assemble an evidence pack. What we can provide: SOC2 Type II redacted report (no raw findings), ISO27001 certificate, and a pen-test attestation letter (signed by our security lead) that states last test date and scope. We do NOT share full pen-test findings without a signed NDA + exec approval. ETA to collate and sign: ~2 business days if I have access to the latest vendor letter.

sarah_legal: Agree. Redacted SOC2 and ISO cert are fine to send after standard DPA/NDA review. If they insist on full pen-test findings -> we require a request form + the customer's signed NDA and an internal approvals check. I'll prepare a standard evidence pack cover letter and NDA template. Who should sign the attestation?

devin_security: I can sign the attestation (Devin H., Head of Security). I'll draft the attestation language and add a short note on remediation windows (we typically state "we remediate critical findings within 30 days, others based on severity").

ana_sales: Customer said they will sign NDA, and specifically asked whether providing these docs will change the POC pricing (they're sensitive to any additional fees). Also asked whether we can mark the SOC2 as "redacted for confidentiality" on the cover.

eric_se: No impact to POC pricing to share these artifacts. Pricing only changes if they want private deployment/on-prem or dedicated support. Cover note saying "redacted for confidentiality" is fine. For the POC we'll also include a short security architecture diagram to show data flows.

devin_security: Plan: assemble these files and upload to secure bucket + generate share link for sale/security. Files I will attach: 
```
- SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf
- ISO27001-certificate.pdf
- pen-test-attestation-DevinH-signed.pdf
- security-architecture-poc.pdf
- evidence-cover-letter.pdf
```
I'll also include a one-page summary for the customer. Need an estimated delivery: if I start today, I can have the pack ready by Friday EOD.

sarah_legal: I'll attach NDA template and sign-off page for the attestation. If customer signs NDA we can send the pen-test attestation. I'll also add a short clause about permitted use of the materials.

ana_sales: Awesome. Please upload and ping me when ready. :thumbsup: Deadline remains EOD Friday.

evidence_bot: Upload completed: gs://redwood-evidence/poc-packages/1771234567/ (access: sales, security, legal). Files: SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf, ISO27001-certificate.pdf, pen-test-attestation-DevinH-signed.pdf, security-architecture-poc.pdf, evidence-cover-letter.pdf

devin_security: Uploaded the files and shared the DM link with @ana_sales. Marking as ready to send.

ana_sales: Sent to Jun (they confirmed receipt). Jun said the pack looks good; they'll sign the NDA tonight. Closing loop here. Thanks everyone.

ana_sales: (follow-up) Jun asked for a short one-line statement we can paste in their procurement system: "Redwood Inference confirms SOC2 Type II coverage as of 2024-11-01 and ISO27001 certification held by Redwood Inference Ltd.; pen-test attestation available upon NDA." Can someone confirm wording?

devin_security: That phrasing is fine. Suggest small tweak: change to "SOC2 Type II coverage as of 2024-11-01 (redacted report available)" to be explicit.

sarah_legal: Approved. Good to send.

ana_sales: Sent final statement to the customer. :white_check_mark: Thread closed.
